CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(First_Response_date__c), NULL, IF( ISBLANK(Request_Date__c), NULL, (5 * FLOOR( (First_Response_date__c - Request_Date__c) / 7 )) + MIN( 5, MOD(First_Response_date__c - Request_Date__c, 7) + MIN(WEEKDAY(Request_Date__c), 6) - MIN(WEEKDAY(First_Response_date__c), 6) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Days to Respond
